complexity.notes: Correct but convoluted: it mutates the caller's input list via pop, relies on negative-index arithmetic for the high pointer, and does up to three O(n) linear scans with list.index. A single-pass hash map of value -> index would be O(n) average time and far more idiomatic.
complexity.summary: Sorts a copy of the array, runs a two-pointer scan to find the two values summing to target, then maps the values back to original indices via list.index (with a pop-and-shift trick for duplicate values).
